summary: OddOneGaming showcases two top-performing teams for the Season 9 Crown Contest against Lightning Guardian (Lightning Fortress), scoring over 3.4 billion total damage. Team one is a Toxin composition led by Serpentemis that hits ~1.45 billion, utilizing specific support sets and a 9.0s ultimate timing on Child of Chaos to ensure an extra ultimate rotation. Team two is a full Radiant Aura lineup starring Talethia that operates on full auto and hits 2.0 billion. The video details exact gear sets, artifact setups, and synergy mechanics like Dragonflame Scorch stacking and derivative damage sharing.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Equipped with Puppeteer's Inspiration and timed to cast ultimate at 9.0s to feed energy to allies so team rotations start earlier.

teams.note: Scored ~1.45B damage. Relies on Might of the Inferno stacking on Twitch/Sleight, Bone Resonance accuracy sharing, and manual 9.0s ultimate timing on Child of Chaos to prevent losing the final ultimate phase.
Scored 2.019B damage on full auto. Talethia acts as primary carry supported by dual Everlasting Candleflame stat sharing, Witch's Remains, and team damage amps.

tips: In Toxin teams, set Child of Chaos to cast his ultimate at 9.0s so Puppeteer's Inspiration grants energy early; starting rotations at 12s causes you to miss the final ultimate rotation and lose 100M-200M damage.
Stack Might of the Inferno on two supports positioned within 1 tile of your main Toxin carry to maximize derivative damage without sacrificing the carry's own offensive gear set.
On Radiant Aura teams, run Everlasting Candleflame on adjacent supports to funnel 15% of their Attack and Defense directly into Talethia.
Equipping Dragonflame Scorch across 3 team members stacks up to 4 times on the lowest HP enemy, granting a 24% increased damage taken debuff.
